import numpy as np

# Data from Treasury Bulletins for individual income tax (in thousands of dollars)
# FY 1929-1941 from 1941_12 bulletin
# FY 1942 from 1943_09 bulletin (revised)
data = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,  # using value from 1943_09 (revised)
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800
}

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000 to get billions)
years = np.array(list(data.keys()))
receipts = np.array([v/1_000_000 for v in data.values()])

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts)

# OLS regression
n = len(years)
sum_x = np.sum(years)
sum_y = np.sum(receipts)
sum_xy = np.sum(years * receipts)
sum_x2 = np.sum(years**2)

# slope = (n*sum_xy - sum_x*sum_y) / (n*sum_x2 - sum_x^2)
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
# intercept = (sum_y - slope*sum_x) / n
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nSlope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Round to nearest thousandth
slope_rounded = round(slope, 3)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept, 3)

print(f"\nRounded Slope: {slope_rounded}")
print(f"Rounded Intercept: {intercept_rounded}")

# Verify with numpy polyfit
slope_np, intercept_np = np.polyfit(years, receipts, 1)
print(f"\nNumpy polyfit Slope: {slope_np}")
print(f"Numpy polyfit Intercept: {intercept_np}")
print(f"Numpy rounded: slope={round(slope_np,3)}, intercept={round(intercept_np,3)}")

# Answer format: [slope, intercept]
answer = f"[{slope_rounded}, {intercept_rounded}]"
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {answer}")
EOF
